Additional style information for certain block kinds.  For example, CODE blocks may have the programming language
for pretty printing.

title.description: The text of the heading that defines this tabs.

section.description: The section of the heading that defines this tab.

title:
A tab is contained in a {@link DocumentationTabSet}, with its tab name. This makes it easier for rendering HTML
(or other output) because the bounds of each tab can be easily identified. The block children will be whatever was
inside the section that defined the tab, without the section itself.

```md
== Stuff
Some stuff
```

The tabs are defined by headings using the `=` leaders (instead of `#`).

@see DocumentationTabSet
name: DocumentationTab
